text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: Are you short on sleep, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. To tell the truth, I was 
watching overseas races late last night...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"From there, once I started thinking about 
how to run on heavy turf and strategies 
for tackling the track, I just couldn't 
fall asleep..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—*phew*... I guess I got a little too 
carried away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel got so caught up in studying 
overseas races that she didn't seem to get 
much rest.
